decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed was significantly diluted with non-backpack items (stoves, towels, tents, sleeping bags), making the search for a specific backpack difficult. I focused my consideration set on actual backpack products. Within this set, I found significant drawbacks: the Granite Gear Virga 2 (prod_backpacks_041) had multiple concerning reports of shoulder straps breaking in wet conditions; the Maxpedition Falcon-III (prod_backpacks_096) is highly durable but carries a high price tag ($171) for its 35L capacity; and the hydration-focused packs like the Gelindo (prod_backpacks_078) and Lunidry (prod_backpacks_196) had mixed reviews regarding the quality of the included bladders and strap durability. Because the high-end technical options appeared unreliable and the budget options felt disposable, I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
